clock.headline: The rules have arrived. Build to them from day one.

rows.text: Decree 330 fines apply: up to 3bn VND, and up to 5% of the previous year's revenue for serious cross-border data transfer breaches.
High-risk AI systems put live from 15 Aug 2026 must comply.
Finance-sector AI systems already live before 15 Aug 2026 must comply.
SBV circular on AI in banking: board-approved AI strategy, human override, emergency stop.

clock.line: Every system we ship carries its evidence: risk class, logs, human override and a kill switch.
clock.smallPrint: A summary for orientation, not legal advice.

offer.line: AWS funding applied for where eligible. Contracted as consulting services.
offer.waysIn: Contact-centre intelligence · Governed analytics with Presight · AI Law readiness review · AI-native engineering for IT

items.a: Where you decide: an AWS Region, the Hanoi Local Zone or your own data centre. Personal data is de-identified before anything leaves your perimeter.

items.q: Who owns the code and the accounts?
items.a: You do. We build in your AWS accounts under your IAM, and you can revoke our access at any time.
As a consulting services engagement: a scoped project, or a fee linked to an agreed outcome.
For eligible projects, we apply for AWS funding on your behalf and handle the paperwork.

items.q: How fast can we go live?
items.a: A new use case goes live for a named user group within one quarter. Where our product already exists it is faster: an investment assistant like T'FOX goes live in 3-4 weeks.

items.q: How do you pass our security review?
items.a: We are ISO/IEC 27001 certified. We work inside your accounts or data centre, under your access policies, with every action logged, and our due-diligence pack includes the certificate and its scope.

items.q: Do you only work on AWS?
items.a: No. AWS is our home, but our Presight proof of concept ran fully on-prem at {c:mbbank}, and the same pattern runs wherever your data must live.

beats.text: Most banks in Vietnam have AI pilots. Very few have AI running in production, with customers, every day.
The model is not the hard part anymore. Vietnamese data is. Governance is. And since March, the AI Law is. That is where pilots stall.

We build the part in the middle. Your people keep their tools, we build the intelligence in Vietnamese, and your data stays where it must. Our investing assistant has run at {c:tps} since April. Our analytics ran fully on-prem inside {c:mbbank}.
So here is our offer: one use case, one quarter, one KPI, with AWS funding where eligible. Book a sprint below, and let's get one thing into production.
